articles.title: Now Google’s Familiar Faces AI feature works on Walmart’s $35 smart home camera too
articles.essence: A couple of Walmart's budget-friendly smart home cameras will be able to recognize people around your house now using Google's familiar face detection feature. A new Google Home update brings Familiar Faces support to the $35 Onn Outdoor Camera Plug-In and $77 Onn Floodlight Camera Hardwired.
articles.full_body: A couple of Walmart's budget-friendly smart home cameras will be able to recognize people around your house now using Google's familiar face detection feature. articles.title: Amazon loses its latest attempt to get out of handling more recall notices
articles.essence: Amazon is on the hook to recall more than 400,000 hazardous products after losing its legal battle against the US Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC). articles.title: Google’s patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment’s future
articles.essence: Last year, Google filed a patent for a system called My Channel that's designed to create feeds filled with personalized, AI-generated videos and advertisements based on information the company knows about its users. The patent has been rejected, but unfortunately, Google might appeal or resubmit an amended version, and we could see this monstrosity come […]
